audit_scope: Worker-4 source-reviewed linked DBAASP/DRAMP rows against reopened primary XML/PDF text and paper-local database snapshots; source conflicts are preserved rather than smoothed.
source_reconciliation_notes: DBAASP MIC/MBC rows were matched directly to reopened XML Table 2 by peptide, organism/strain, endpoint, and value.
BotrAMP14 and CrotAMP14 primary sequences and C-terminal amidation were checked from the PDF text sequence paragraph.
DRAMP broad Anticancer annotations are preserved as source_conflict because the primary paper does not directly assay anticancer activity.
The DBAASP BotrAMP14 Galleria row is preserved as source_conflict because its database killing percentage does not match the source peptide-specific survival value.
